ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate child care fraud in multiple states, including Minnesota and Washington
questions: How much taxpayer money is being misused?
What are the consequences for those involved?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. By analyzing data and public records, we can uncover the extent of the issue and identify patterns and connections between entities.
